description: This file is an HTML webpage for visualizing and interacting with a database management interface. It includes the structure, styles, and scripts necessary for displaying database list, tables, and data in a web UI.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar menu.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and inserts the data table HTML into the DOM.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or a truncated preview.

search-terms: UI for database tables and data
